div.div: On this machine: reset → M (BIOS, then OpenSBI) → MRET with MPP = S → S (Linux) → SRET with SPP = U → U (BusyBox). ECALL from S reaches OpenSBI in M (cause 9); ECALL and page faults from U are delegated to the kernel in S.

text.tspan: On this machine: reset → M (BIOS, then OpenSBI) → MRET with MPP = S → S (Linux) → SRET with SPP = U → U (BusyBox). ECALL
from S reaches OpenSBI in M (cause 9); ECALL and page faults from U are delegated to the kernel in S.
